race.comment: LEONCHROI (5) was well supported in the Ansett Classic at Mornington last start but never got a real crack at them in a bit of a train wreck for punters, beaten 1.2 lengths into fourth. He won dominantly prior in a BM78 under Blake Shinn who jumps back aboard here and can prove the difference. AUTUMNHEAT (11) got to this trip at Geelong and stayed strongly from the front to win well. Gets in on the minimum and draws to do no work, he can give a sight. FEDERER (7) isn't the most reliable conveyance but has the ability, one go this trip didn't work out but he's bred to stay all day, perhaps he needs a quiet ride? BEACH PAD (3) is consistent and should run well from FERNAO (2) who is going okay and comes back in class.
